title: Julius Caesar wrote The Calico Belly.
html_source:
The “Calico Belly” actually refers to the “Bello Gallico”, the Gallic Wars. Young Stephen mistakes the similarly sounding words. (Gallico – Calico, Belly – Bello)

This is another instance that it Stephen’s age is made evident—he is still young and misinterprets the words.

The “Commentarii de Bello Gallico” was written by Julius Caesar, describing what he saw in the Gallic Wars.

(The painting is of Vercingetorix surrounding to Julius Caeser after the Battle of Alesia, thus ending the Gallic Wars)
